newsitem.title: USA: Brunswick agrees to buy Igloo for $154 mln. [CORRECTED 15:53 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Brunswick agrees to buy Igloo for $154 mln. [CORRECTED 15:53 GMT]

text.p: Brunswick Corp said Tuesday (corrects from Monday) it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Igloo Holdings Inc for about $154 million in cash.
Igloo, based in Houston, Texas, makes ice chests, beverage coolers and thermoelectric cooler/warmer products. It has annual sales of about $150 million.
Igloo will become part of the Brunswick Outdoor Recreation Group, based in Tulsa.
The company said completion of the transaction is scheduled for early 1997 and is subject to customary closing conditions.
Brunswick provides outdoor and indoor recreation products.
